summary.title: Threat Model for TDT4237
summary.description:
* manage the bookings and logistics of a luxury resort.
* guarantee discretion for all of the guests, who often register under pseudonyms in the system
* keep accurate guest information in order to manage billing, as well as keeping track of food preferences, personal requests and special room service
* manage surveillance data from the resort premises to detect unwanted intruders. 
          * AI-based facial recognition should be used to map people in video recordings with legit guests and staff members in the system.
